name: Intuition
description: What comes to mind for a request without being asked for: cards and facts the Subconscious offers because they are close to the request, which the Mind may take or ignore.
approach: Offer the closest items to a request, within a budget, and let the Mind take or ignore them.
out_of_scope: Answering a query (the Context Retriever does that).
milestones: 1. An offered item is useful often enough that it is kept (metric-the-intuition).
measures_of_success: An offered item is useful often enough that it is kept.
outputs: Items offered to the Mind for a request.
effects: Reads and writes nothing itself: it calls the entry points of the parts it uses.
usage_notes: No arm yet: the seat is defined and empty.
